resubmission_linked.fail: This submittal is at revision {revision}, but no review of revision {previous} is recorded, so nobody can read why it was sent in again
resubmission_linked.suggestion: Reach a new revision through a review marked revise and resubmit, or correct the revision number

outcome_matches_status.fail: The reviewer's stamp says {outcome}, but the submittal's status is {status}
outcome_matches_status.suggestion: Record the decision through the review action so the stamp and the status move together

required_on_site_after_submitted.fail: The item is required on site on {on_site}, before its submittal was filed on {submitted}
required_on_site_after_submitted.suggestion: Correct the required on site date, or record that the delivery date is already lost

long_lead_has_lead_time.fail: This submittal is marked long lead but has no lead time, so the date its approval is needed by cannot be worked out
long_lead_has_lead_time.suggestion: Enter the lead time in weeks from order to delivery on site

approval_needed_by_not_passed.fail: Approval was needed by {needed_by} for the item to arrive in time; it is still not approved {days} days later
approval_needed_by_not_passed.suggestion: Chase the review, or agree a later required on site date with the programme

material_has_manufacturer.fail: This material submittal names no manufacturer, so the reviewer has no product to approve
material_has_manufacturer.suggestion: Enter the manufacturer or brand being offered
